svg.text: Each arrow points from a unit to a unit it uses (its uses clause). Units higher up depend on units lower down; nothing points upwards, so there are no cycles.

Generated from the source on 2026-10-22 (62 units, 192 uses). Light arrows go to the shared basics (uTypes, uCommands, uStopwatch, uIOGate, uMemoryGuard); dashed = used in the implementation section only.
fast TIFF: raw rows, own LZW
find / start TC, side by side
since 1.0: containers (ZIP / CBZ), folder thumbnails, safe settings, dir preview, lossless rotation.
L0 … L7: dependency depth (L0 uses no other MView unit). Dashed box: retired unit, still compiled. Versarite Image Lab adds its own units on top of these, in source\microscopy\ (not shown).
